description: This file defines a template class 'StateTrigger' within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class manages state transitions and synchronization mechanisms, including waiting for specific states, setting states, and thread safety features. It appears to be part of a larger system for state management and event handling in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: StateTrigger
classes.description: A template class that manages a state machine with thread synchronization, allowing waiting for specific states, setting states, and thread-safe access.

methods.name: WaitState
methods.description: Blocks until the specified state is reached or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitStateClear
methods.description: Blocks until the specified state is cleared or timeout occurs.

methods.name: SetState
methods.description: Sets the current state and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if the current state equals the given state.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if the current state does not equal the given state.
